title: Intermediate Financial and Cost Mgmt Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Intermediate Financial and Cost Mgmt Analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Ensure financial planning, cost control, and financial governance for Platform / Technology areas.

Sof Skills:

  • Ability to work closely with stakeholders from various departments, ensuring all necessary alignments for project delivery.
  • Strong documentation and organizational skills.
  • Organized profile, capable of working autonomously while being willing to seek help when needed.
  • Ownership of the processes end-to-end.
  • Accountability of the reports delivered.

title: Senior Golang Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Golang Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Please note that the project operates in the UK time zone.


We are seeking a dedicated, motivated, and reliable Senior Golang Engineer who is interested in providing innovative software solutions for our clients. Be a part of our team as we continue to deliver high quality products and services. The Senior Go Engineer will be responsible for building backend services in Go in EKS, as well as some Lambdas. The overall project will be centered around providing product data and managing the product life cycle. If you are an open communicator with a passion for learning, love to think outside the box and you are excited about software development, we are looking for you!


RESPONSIBILITIES

• Use your deep expertise in Go and related technologies to develop high-quality, scalable, maintainable software solutions.

• Make technically sound decisions and champion high standards of coding and architecture best practices.

• Develop and maintain software documentation such as technical specifications and design documents.

• Continually enhance the team’s performance by mentoring, code reviews, and improving current processes in the SDLC.

• Troubleshoot and debug software issues as they arise.

• Collaborate within a cross functional team and be able to transform both functional and non-functional requirements into actionable work.

• Manage communication of progress/status to stakeholders.


WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• At least 4 years of professional software development experience.

• Proficiency in Go (Golang), including syntax, semantics, database connectivity, and object-oriented concepts.

• Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms.

• Experience working with Go frameworks such as Gin, Revel, Echo, Beego, etc.

• Strong understanding of web services (HTTP, SOAP, REST, GQL, etc.).

• Terraform, Lambdas, Writing API’s.

• Strong working knowledge of relational databases.

• Experience in troubleshooting issues and root cause analysis.

• A proven track record of delivering high quality and tested software on-time and often.

• An open mind, and the patience to explain issues in a constructive manner.

• Strong communication skills, with at least an intermediate level of English.

• Experience working in distributed, cross functional teams.


NICE TO HAVE

• Kubernetes or EKS.

• Algolia.

• Shopify.

• DynamoDB


Who We Are?

We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.


What's In It For You

  • We offer 100% remote work
  • Wellness/Fitness package
  • Paid trainings and certifications
  • 22 days of paid leave (27 days in the second year with us)
  • Professional Conferences and Training
  • Global Team Building Activities
  • Access to co-working spaces worldwide


Your applications and referrals are welcome!

Experience with Adobe InDesign or similar.

Experience with proposal database software Deltek Vision or similar.

Willingness to work EST hours

title: Engenheiro IA
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro IA em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de IA experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.


Duties and Responsibilities:

• Pesquisar, desenvolver e implementar metodologias avançadas de Large Language Models (LLMs) para criação de produtos de dados baseados em IA generativa.

• Desenvolver e aprimorar técnicas de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), combinando embeddings e bancos de vetores para melhorar precisão e relevância das respostas dos modelos.

• Aplicar técnicas de segurança e governança para IA generativa, mitigando alucinações, viés e riscos éticos no uso de LLMs.

• Automatizar e monitorar o desempenho de modelos generativos em produção, utilizando frameworks de MLOps e ferramentas de observabilidade de IA.

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de engenharia, produto e negócio para transformar desafios empresariais em soluções escaláveis baseadas em IA generativa.


Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

• Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e aplicação de LLMs e fluxos agênticos.

• Forte domínio de Python, frameworks como LangGraph, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex, e ferramentas de MLOps para produção de modelos generativos.

• Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.

• Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.

• Experiência com deploy e monitoramento de modelos em produção, incluindo técnicas de inferência eficiente, caching e otimização.

• Familiaridade com conceitos de governança, segurança e alinhamento de modelos generativos.


Minimum Education:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Inglês Fluente

title: SAP Logistics Solution Architect – SD & MM
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para SAP Logistics Solution Architect – SD & MM em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

SAP Logistics Solution Architect – SD & MM


About Pyxus


We are a global company with more than 150 years of history, committed to creating a better-growing world. Our mission is to produce high-quality products and ingredients through sustainable practices, ensuring social, environmental, and production traceability, while promoting the well-being of farmers and the communities we serve.

As part of the Pyxus group, Alliance One Brasil shares this vision, and we believe in a future where people are inspired to achieve excellence, communities are strengthened by trust and innovation, and value is created through a commitment to serve. Our culture is built on resilience, accountability, encouragement, and transparency, and we value each team member for their experience, knowledge, and passion.

Join Pyxus and help us grow a better world together!


Key Responsibilities

  • Leads end-to-end SAP logistics architecture (OTC and PTP), defining global templates and ensuring integration with core modules and external systems.
  • Partners with business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable SAP solutions and governs adherence to standards and architecture principles.
  • Designs and integrates complex SD and MM solutions (pricing, billing, transport, procurement, inventory), prioritizing standard SAP functionality.
  • Drives S/4HANA transformation initiatives, defining target architecture, supporting conversions, and promoting Fiori and modern UX.
  • Ensures quality and compliance through testing strategies, audit alignment, and support for go-live, hypercare, and production stability.
  • Promotes continuous improvement by driving simplification, automation, process optimization, and resolving critical production issues.


Qualifications/Requirements

  • Fluent English
  • Strong SAP experience with deep expertise in SD and MM
  • Proven Solution Architect or Lead Functional Consultant experience
  • Strong understanding of end‑to‑end logistics and supply chain processes
  • Hands‑on experience with S/4HANA implementations or conversions
  • Experience in global, multi‑company, multi‑country SAP environments
  • Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills


Benefits

Profit-Sharing Program (PPR)

Health Insurance Plans

50% Medication Allowance

Mobile Phone Plan

Private Pension Plan

Meal Card

Employee Assistance Program – Mental Health and Well-being

Corporate Time Off Days

Wellhub

Group Life Insurance


Applications are open until May 31, 2026.

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Salesforce Developer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Salesforce Developer

Brazil


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary


We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).



Responsibilities and Duties


  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.



Essential Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership;
  • Advanced English to be in contact with customer representative on a daily basis.




Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).



About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


Estamos expandindo nosso time de tecnologia e buscamos profissionais para atuar na fronteira da inteligência artificial aplicada aos setores financeiro e securitário. O foco será a construção de ecossistemas inteligentes, indo além de modelos isolados para criar arquiteturas de agentes capazes de resolver demandas complexas de negócio e backoffice.


O DESAFIO:


  • Orquestração e Agentes: Projetar sistemas multiagentes utilizando LangGraph ou Agent Squad para decompor tarefas complexas em workflows automatizados.
  • Observabilidade e Tracing (Prioridade): Implementar o rastreamento completo da \"cadeia de pensamento\" (Chain of Thought) e execução dos agentes.
  • Monitoramento de Performance: Utilizar ferramentas como Langfuse ou LangSmith para monitorar latência, consumo de tokens e qualidade das respostas em tempo real.
  • Desenvolvimento de Ferramentas: Criar conexões seguras entre LLMs e APIs externas via Model Context Protocol (MCP) , garantindo o isolamento e a segurança dos dados.
  • Arquitetura RAG: Otimizar pipelines de recuperação de informação utilizando Vector Stores (Pinecone ou MongoDB ) para mitigar alucinações e aumentar a precisão contextual.
  • Infraestrutura Cloud: Gerenciar deploys em ambientes AWS ou Azure e integrar modelos via AWS Bedrock ou Azure OpenAI Service , priorizando arquiteturas Serverless e Event-Driven.
  • AI Guardrails: Implementar camadas de filtragem e validação de prompts/outputs para evitar injeções de código ou desvios éticos.
  • Avaliação Sistemática: Desenvolver frameworks de testes (Evals) para validar a eficácia de novas funcionalidades antes do deploy em produção.
  • Eficiência de Custos: Monitorar e otimizar o uso de modelos (Model Routing) para equilibrar performance e custo operacional.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:


  • Linguagens: Domínio avançado de Python e Java para automação de workflows e integraçoes e desenvolvimento de IA.
  • DevOps/MLOps: Experiência com Docker , Containerization e práticas de CI/CD para modelos de linguagem.
  • Educação: Graduação em Engenharia de Computação ou áreas correlatas.


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:


  • Experiência prévia na construção de assistentes inteligentes escaláveis (ex: via WhatsApp) e pesquisa em Explainable AI (XAI) .



O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ


️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

O DESAFIO:


  • Orquestração e Agentes: Projetar sistemas multiagentes utilizando LangGraph ou Agent Squad para decompor tarefas complexas em workflows automatizados.

title: Data Scientist - Sênior (Motor de Busca)
description:

Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na squad de Busca, com foco em Busca Semântica, relevância e ranking. Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e evoluir soluções de Busca Semântica utilizando Elasticsearch, indo além da busca lexical tradicional.
  • Atuar na definição e otimização de: Estrutura de índices e mappings Estratégias de ranking híbrido (lexical + semântico) Queries semânticas (ex: embeddings, similarity search, boosting contextual)
  • Trabalhar com vetorização de conteúdo (produtos, termos de busca, atributos) para melhoria de relevância.
  • Avaliar e evoluir métricas de qualidade de busca. Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar impacto das melhorias semânticas. Traduzir problemas de negócio e experiência do usuário em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados.
  • Atuar em parceria com Engenharia e Produto na definição do roadmap técnico de busca. Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time, elevando o nível das discussões técnicas.


Requisitos necessários

  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins. Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados.
  • Experiência prática com Busca Semântica em Elasticsearch
  • Experiência com Information Retrieval (IR) e conceitos de relevância.
  • Conhecimento em NLP aplicado à busca (ex: embeddings, similaridade textual).
  • Experiência com modelos de ranking ou learning to rank.
  • Domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem.
  • Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto.
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume de dados. Noções de MLOps.
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.


Diferenciais

  • Vivência com BigQuery ou data lakes.
  • Experiência prévia em e-commerce, marketplace ou plataformas de discovery.
  • Experiência em observabilidade e monitoramento da qualidade da busca.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.


Perfil esperado

  • Forte mentalidade de produto e experiência do usuário.
  • Perfil analítico, curioso e orientado a impacto.
  • Autonomia para conduzir iniciativas complexas de ponta a ponta.
  • Capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas e de produto com dados.
  • Boa colaboração em times multidisciplinares.

title: AI Automation Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Automation Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Hey, Dingus!


Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a sharp, systems-minded AI Automation Specialist who can build, connect, and scale intelligent workflows that actually work in production.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


What You’ll Do


  • Build and maintain automated workflows using N8N, connecting APIs, webhooks, and data sources into seamless pipelines.
  • Integrate and prompt Claude (Anthropic) and other LLMs into production systems, not just experiments.
  • Manage and automate data operations in Airtable, including scripted fields, automations, and structured data pipelines.
  • Design AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort across client delivery, internal ops, and content production.
  • Troubleshoot broken pipelines, handle edge cases, and document systems so they don’t live only in your head.
  • Collaborate with strategy and delivery teams to identify automation opportunities and scope builds accurately.
  • Stay current on the AI tooling landscape, you should know what’s worth using before we ask.
  • Own and iterate on AI agent logic and system prompts, understanding why a workflow behaves the way it does and improving it over time.
  • Build net-new internal AI tools as the business identifies opportunities, not just maintain what exists.


What You Bring


  • 2+ years of hands-on experience building automated workflows (N8N, Make.com, or Zapier, N8N strongly preferred).
  • Real experience integrating LLMs via API (Claude, GPT, or equivalent) into production pipelines with structured outputs.
  • Proficiency in Airtable as a data layer, scripting, automations, relational structures.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and webhook-based integrations.
  • Basic scripting ability in Python or JavaScript, enough to write and debug function nodes without hand-holding.
  • A working understanding of HTML and CSS is imperative, you need to be able to read, interpret, and make sense of front-end structure when workflows touch web-based outputs.
  • A systems thinker mindset: you design the whole loop, not just the happy path.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Comfort with versioning and testing AI outputs, you notice when a prompt change breaks something and know how to fix it.


Bonus Points


  • Experience with vector databases or basic RAG pipelines (Pinecone, Supabase, etc.).
  • Familiarity with AI agent frameworks (LangChain, or equivalent concepts).
  • Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment.
  • Exposure to prompt engineering best practices, like system prompts, chaining, few-shot design.


Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you’re someone who can look at a messy manual process, see the system hiding inside it, and build something that runs without you, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Data Annotator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Annotator em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who is Blueprint Technologies?

We are a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with a strong presence across the United States and an expanding footprint across Latin America (LATAM). Our teams are united by a shared passion for solving complex problems.


At Blueprint, we use technology as a bridge between strategy and execution. Our people bring diverse perspectives, deep expertise, and real-world experience across industries to help organizations grow, transform, and innovate.


About the Role

We are seeking detail-oriented Labelers / Annotators to evaluate responses generated by AI systems across multiple languages .


This role focuses on side-by-side (SBS) evaluation of outputs from different AI models across real-world scenarios. You will play a key role in improving how AI systems understand and communicate across languages and cultures.


This is not a translation role . It is an evaluation and analysis role requiring strong judgment and attention to detail.


Language Requirement

Fluency in English + at least one of the following languages:

  • Chinese (Simplified and/or Traditional)
  • Japanese
  • Korean
  • Italian
  • German
  • French


What You’ll Work On

You will evaluate AI responses across scenarios such as:

  • General-purpose Q&A
  • Web search results
  • File-based and image-based responses
  • Image and file generation tasks
  • Single-turn and multi-turn conversations


Responsibilities

  • Perform side-by-side (SBS) comparisons of AI-generated responses
  • Evaluate outputs based on:
  • Accuracy
  • Relevance
  • Clarity
  • Instruction-following
  • Identify nuances in tone, meaning, and cultural context across languages
  • Apply detailed, scenario-specific annotation guidelines
  • Maintain consistency and high-quality evaluations


Required Qualifications

  • Professional fluency in English + at least one target language listed above
  • Prior experience with side-by-side (SBS) labeling or annotation
  • Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail
  • Ability to quickly understand and apply structured evaluation frameworks


Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in linguistics, translation, or localization
  • Experience in:
  • AI evaluation
  • Data annotation
  • Search relevance or content quality analysis


Compensation

We offer competitive compensation aligned with local markets and experience.

Estimated hourly range: R$75 – R$85 BRL

Estimated monthly equivalent (full-time): R$12,000 – R$13,600 BRL

Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity.


Training & Qualification

All new hires will complete a structured onboarding program, including:

  • Training sessions and practice exercises
  • Calibration against quality benchmarks
  • Qualification review before moving into production work


Benefits & Employment Structure

This role is hired through an Employer of Record (EOR) partner, ensuring full compliance with local labor laws and payroll requirements.

Employees receive locally compliant benefits, which may include:

  • Statutory benefits (e.g., paid leave, 13th salary where applicable)
  • Social security and healthcare contributions
  • Additional benefits aligned with local market practices


Why Blueprint?

  • Work on cutting-edge AI systems
  • Be part of a global, multilingual team
  • Build highly transferable AI evaluation skills
  • Contribute directly to improving real-world AI experiences


Equal Opportunity Employer

Blueprint Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, or any other protected status.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Bookkeeper em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Join Aerial Core - the back office that keeps pace with your ambition

Aerial Core is a modern, tech-enabled back-office partner that supports growing businesses through accounting, finance, and people operations services. We’ve intentionally broken the mold of traditional accounting firms by placing relationships, collaboration, and innovation at the center of how we work.

At Aerial Core, we believe accounting should be more than compliance, it should be strategic, insightful, and human-driven. Our people-first culture values trust, independence, and efficiency, empowering every team member to do their best work while helping clients thrive.

We’re now looking for a tech-savvy, detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our remote team. Please be informed that this is a contractor position and we will require your CNPJ, this is the perfect opportunity for professionals who value autonomy, flexibility and performance based rewards. You’ll work directly with clients, manage their day-to-day financial operations, and leverage technology to deliver accurate, timely, and strategic bookkeeping support.

What You'll Do

  • Handle full-cycle bookkeeping for assigned clients, including AP/AR, bank reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Maintain accurate financial data using QuickBooks or other cloud-based accounting tools.
  • Prepare clear, insightful financial reports that help clients make better decisions.
  • Communicate with clients and team members through Slack, Zoom, and Google Workspace.
  • Use Asana and Everhour to track projects, deliverables, and timelines.
  • Proactively identify ways to improve processes, automate tasks, and increase efficiency.
  • Prepare necessary documentation and reports for internal and external audit processes.
  • Ensure compliance with accounting standards and Aerial Core’s quality expectations.

What We're Looking For

  • Fluent in English
  • Proven experience in bookkeeping or accounting 
  • Flexibility around working hours, with the understanding that some tasks may require availability during US business hours (mainly Pacific Time)
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and accuracy
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to manage multiple clients independently
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment using digital tools.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Asana and Everhour or any other workflow automation tools
  • Familiarity with CRMs or project management systems such as Asana
  • Prior experience working with startups or small businesses


Why You'll Love Working With Us

At Aerial Core, we do things differently:

  • Trust and Independence: You are your own boss. We trust your expertise and give you the freedom to manage your time and workload.
  • Efficiency and Innovation: We embrace technology and encourage experimentation. If you find a better way to work, we’ll support it.
  • Collaboration and Growth: We win as a team. Our culture is built on helping each other, learning together, and celebrating shared success.
  • Performance-Driven Rewards: Your efforts directly impact your earnings. You’ll receive a retainer contract of R$3,300 with the option to qualify for more contracts. 
  • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere, anytime as long as deadlines are met and excellence is maintained.

The Aerial Core Way

  • Relationships over Transactions: We build lasting relationships by deeply understanding our clients and delivering real value.
  • Strategic Thinking & Judgment: We go beyond the surface, identifying root causes and providing actionable insights.
  • Open Communication: We value transparency and see mistakes as opportunities for growth.
  • Excellence & Accountability: We aim for 10/10 work — delivered early, reviewed thoroughly, and executed with care.

﻿

Ready to do accounting differently?

Join a modern, digital-first team where your independence, innovation, and impact truly matter.

Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.


Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.


Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento.

Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:


Integridade : Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Entusiasmo: Acreditamos que o entusiasmo e a positividade são essenciais para o sucesso. Quem ama o que faz trabalha com alegria e aproveita a jornada.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.


Estamos procurando profissionais dinâmicos e proativos, com uma atitude positiva e habilidades em negócios e sistemas para trabalho em equipe. Valorizamos paciência, comprometimento e a capacidade de lidar bem com usuários e clientes.

Se você já tem experiência em implantação de sistemas, excelente! Caso contrário, oferecemos um ambiente onde você pode aprender constantemente. Fazer parte da nossa equipe exige dedicação e disposição para adquirir um profundo conhecimento sobre nosso sistema.

Esta oportunidade inclui viagens para várias localidades do Brasil.


Responsabilidades:


  • Executar a implantação de sistemas, estando alocado ou não no cliente, ministrando treinamentos para gestores e colaboradores do cliente;
  • Ministrar treinamentos acerca das parametrizações e demais funcionalidades garantindo pleno conhecimento e satisfação do cliente;
  • Preparar documentação dos módulos correspondentes;
  • Realizar testes das funcionalidades considerando as regras de negócios do ERP;
  • Participar de reuniões, inclusive com o cliente, parceiros da Bluesoft e a equipe da Bluesoft;
  • Documentar os treinamentos e enviar relatório de atendimento que demonstre a evolução dos treinamentos ministrados e enviar às partes interessadas.


Requisitos:


  • Residir na Grande São Paulo;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;


Importante: Na Bluesoft, cada consultor atua no módulo em que possui mais experiência e familiaridade. Ou seja, você não precisará dominar todos os módulos — vamos direcionar sua atuação com base no seu principal conhecimento. Abaixo, detalhamos o que esperamos de conhecimento e experiência em cada módulo:


  • Conhecimento Contábil: Plano de Contas, Lançamentos Contábeis, Conciliações Contábeis, Conhecimento de obrigações Acessórias (ECD e ECF), Ativo Imobilizado, Depreciação e Amortização, CIAP, Contabilização de Folha de Pagamento, Apuração de IRPJ e CSLL, etc.
  • Conhecimento Fiscal: ICMS, ICMS ST, PIS, COFINS, DIFAL, FCP, IPI, FUNRURAL, Sped Fiscal, Sped Contribuições, EFD REINF, NCM, CEST, CST, CFOP, retenções na fonte sobre serviços tomados/prestados (IRRF, CSRF, ISS, INSS).
  • Conhecimento Supply Chain: Rotina de Compras, Pricing (Precificação de Produtos e Margem Líquida), Recebimento de Mercadorias, Conhecimento Básico da Tributação (NCM, IPI, ICMS, PIS), Processos no Varejo.



Requisitos Desejáveis:


  • Familiaridade com análise de atualizações na legislação societária e normas contábeis;
  • Conhecimento ou vivência no Comercial de redes varejistas, como comprador ou assistente de compras;
  • Experiência com Implantação de Sistemas/Consultor de ERP ou como Key User (usuário chave) de ERP;
  • Ensino Superior em Administração, Finanças, Ciências Contábeis ou cursos relacionados à Gestão e Negócios;
  • Experiência com Varejo;
  • Familiaridade com PDVs e arquivos de cupons fiscais;
  • Experiência no Comercial de redes varejistas, como comprador ou assistente de compras;
  • Visão analítica para apresentação de relatórios de BI com o objetivo de atender às necessidades do cliente;
  • Resiliência e capacidade de autoaprendizagem.

title: Senior ML engineer | Fully remote | B2B
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior ML engineer | Fully remote | B2B em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who enjoys turning messy web data into structured, reliable company intelligence.


This is not a research role, management track or career step for people who mainly want to move up. It is a hands on engineering role for someone who gets satisfaction from solving complex data problems properly.


About us

Fullinfo is a self funded software company building a B2B company intelligence platform.

We continuously crawl the open web and turn unstructured company websites, directories, registries and industry sources into clean, searchable company profiles. The result is a global database where users can search for specific company data and actually get the right answer.

The product helps sales and marketing teams search across company data in a way that feels simple on the surface, but is technically complex underneath. Think natural language search, structured filters, company enrichment, relationship detection and reliable classification across many countries, industries and languages.


Fullinfo currently works with a compact team of around 11 people, including backend engineers, frontend engineers, UX UI designers, DevOps and machine learning specialists. The team is small, international and focused on people who actually build, improve and ship the product.

The culture is calm, direct and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. There is little room for ego, politics or vague ambition talk. The best fit is someone who is quietly driven, technically strong and genuinely interested in building something that works well.

This is not the environment for people who constantly reinvent their profile, chase the next title or need a lot of structure around them. It is a strong fit for stable engineers who know their craft and like working with other people who take quality seriously.


Role description

As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on the intelligence layer at the heart of Fullinfo’s product.


Your work turns raw, noisy and unstructured web content into trustworthy data points. This includes things like industry classification, company maturity stage, tech stack, geography served, corporate hierarchy, entity matching and relationship detection.

You will write Python, build and improve ML pipelines, integrate LLMs, evaluate model quality and make sure the system keeps producing accurate results at scale.


The stack includes Python, Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers, boto3, AWS Lambda, SageMaker, S3, ECS, Terraform, Go and TypeScript.

You will work closely with a small engineering team, but this is not a role where someone tells you every step to take. The direction is clear, the expectations are high, and the work needs to be done properly. You need to be comfortable figuring things out, validating assumptions and improving quality without needing constant confirmation.


Your work includes:

• Designing and improving models for classification, entity resolution and relationship detection

• Working with noisy web scraped data across many languages and formats

• Building ML pipelines that run reliably in production

• Using LLMs for extraction, enrichment, validation and search related use cases

• Working with embeddings, RAG, fine tuning and prompt engineering where it actually adds value

• Defining evaluation metrics so model quality is measurable instead of based on gut feeling

• Monitoring deployed models and improving them over time

• Working with AWS services such as Lambda, SageMaker, S3 and ECS

• Collaborating with backend engineers on production systems and data flows


This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problems more than status. Someone who would rather fix a broken classification result than talk about building a team under them.


Requirements

You bring:

• At least 5 years of hands on ML engineering experience

• Strong Python skills

• Experience with libraries such as Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers and boto3

• Real production experience with ML on AWS

• Experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering or fine tuning

• Comfort working with large scale, messy and semi structured data

• Experience with JSON, NoSQL data and scraped web content

• A strong eye for correctness and data quality

• Business level English

• The ability to work independently in a small remote team

• A stable track record that shows depth, consistency and ownership


Conditions

• 12 month B2B contract

• Fully remote work (GMT -3), you are allowed to have a 3 hour overlap

• Flat structure with direct communication

• Production product with real users and real data problems

• Strong technical challenge around ML, LLMs, search and company intelligence

• Compensation based on senior contractor level


The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team.


Interested? Apply trough the link and get in touch with our consultant Lars

Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo’s needs.

title: Senior ML engineer | Fully remote | B2B
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior ML engineer | Fully remote | B2B em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who enjoys turning messy web data into structured, reliable company intelligence.


This is not a research role, management track or career step for people who mainly want to move up. It is a hands on engineering role for someone who gets satisfaction from solving complex data problems properly.


About us

Fullinfo is a self funded software company building a B2B company intelligence platform.

We continuously crawl the open web and turn unstructured company websites, directories, registries and industry sources into clean, searchable company profiles. The result is a global database where users can search for specific company data and actually get the right answer.

The product helps sales and marketing teams search across company data in a way that feels simple on the surface, but is technically complex underneath. Think natural language search, structured filters, company enrichment, relationship detection and reliable classification across many countries, industries and languages.


Fullinfo currently works with a compact team of around 11 people, including backend engineers, frontend engineers, UX UI designers, DevOps and machine learning specialists. The team is small, international and focused on people who actually build, improve and ship the product.

The culture is calm, direct and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. There is little room for ego, politics or vague ambition talk. The best fit is someone who is quietly driven, technically strong and genuinely interested in building something that works well.

This is not the environment for people who constantly reinvent their profile, chase the next title or need a lot of structure around them. It is a strong fit for stable engineers who know their craft and like working with other people who take quality seriously.


Role description

As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on the intelligence layer at the heart of Fullinfo’s product.


Your work turns raw, noisy and unstructured web content into trustworthy data points. This includes things like industry classification, company maturity stage, tech stack, geography served, corporate hierarchy, entity matching and relationship detection.

You will write Python, build and improve ML pipelines, integrate LLMs, evaluate model quality and make sure the system keeps producing accurate results at scale.


The stack includes Python, Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers, boto3, AWS Lambda, SageMaker, S3, ECS, Terraform, Go and TypeScript.

You will work closely with a small engineering team, but this is not a role where someone tells you every step to take. The direction is clear, the expectations are high, and the work needs to be done properly. You need to be comfortable figuring things out, validating assumptions and improving quality without needing constant confirmation.


Your work includes:

• Designing and improving models for classification, entity resolution and relationship detection

• Working with noisy web scraped data across many languages and formats

• Building ML pipelines that run reliably in production

• Using LLMs for extraction, enrichment, validation and search related use cases

• Working with embeddings, RAG, fine tuning and prompt engineering where it actually adds value

• Defining evaluation metrics so model quality is measurable instead of based on gut feeling

• Monitoring deployed models and improving them over time

• Working with AWS services such as Lambda, SageMaker, S3 and ECS

• Collaborating with backend engineers on production systems and data flows


This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problems more than status. Someone who would rather fix a broken classification result than talk about building a team under them.


Requirements

You bring:

• At least 5 years of hands on ML engineering experience

• Strong Python skills

• Experience with libraries such as Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers and boto3

• Real production experience with ML on AWS

• Experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering or fine tuning

• Comfort working with large scale, messy and semi structured data

• Experience with JSON, NoSQL data and scraped web content

• A strong eye for correctness and data quality

• Business level English

• The ability to work independently in a small remote team

• A stable track record that shows depth, consistency and ownership


Conditions

• 12 month B2B contract

• Fully remote work (GMT -3), you are allowed to have a 3 hour overlap

• Flat structure with direct communication

• Production product with real users and real data problems

• Strong technical challenge around ML, LLMs, search and company intelligence

• Compensation based on senior contractor level


The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team.


Interested? Apply trough the link and get in touch with our consultant Lars

Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo’s needs.

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Success Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.



Please share your resume in English.



Responsibilities:


  • Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage.
  • Increase JoVE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes.
  • Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits.
  • Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of JoVE resources.
  • Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams.


Requirements:


  • A master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines.
  • Experience in science communications, academic outreach or other customer-facing roles is preferred.
  • Fluent communication skills English.
  • Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.e. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building.
  • Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred.


Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de Dados Sênior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Volpi

Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário . Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiências inteligentes, simples e digitais . Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!


O desafio

Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.

Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.

Aqui, você terá alto nível de autonomia e ownership , tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi , com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS;
  • Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
  • Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance ;
  • Lidar com dados distribuídos em múltiplos silos , conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio;
  • Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
  • Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
  • Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros , incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados;
  • Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida como Data Engineer , com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev);
  • Domínio de Python e SQL para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção;
  • Experiência prática com AWS , especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM;
  • Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) ;
  • Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
  • Forte preocupação com segurança da informação , padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Experiência em ambientes de startup , lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero;
  • Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
  • Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos.


Será considerado um diferencial:

  • Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
  • Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);
  • Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;
  • Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início.



Benefícios que oferecemos:

  • Modelo remoto prioritário
  • Plano de saúde Alice (100% pago para titular e dependentes)
  • R$600/ano para infraestrutura de home office
  • R$1.000/ano de auxílio educação

  • Day off no aniversário

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Machine Learning Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‑generation AI‑native B2B platform for hospitality. We’re looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially the mathematical and statistical foundations behind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you’re someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you’ll feel at home here.


This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect , help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you’ll love working with us.


What you’ll do

  • Design, train, and improve statistical and machine learning models for real product use cases.
  • Apply strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and modeling to make sound decisions on approach and evaluation.
  • Build scalable ML solutions that can be used reliably in production environments.
  • Develop capabilities to support agent-like experiences within our platform (e.g., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails).
  • Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results.


What we’re looking for

We’re intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you’re strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we’d love to hear from you.

You’ll be successful in this role if you have :

  • Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately.
  • Solid grounding in statistics and mathematical reasoning (e.g., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design).
  • Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration.
  • Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code.
  • Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow).

Nice to have (not required)

  • Experience with NLP and/or LLMs (helpful, but not a core requirement).
  • Exposure to ML-related capabilities on AWS , such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.g., SageMaker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML.
  • Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding-based retrieval .


Why Join Us

You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You’ll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction.


Equal Opportunity

Directful is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic.

title: Customer Loyalty Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Loyalty Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. We’re building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?


About you:

This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Loyalty Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you’ll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.


What You’ll Own:

  • Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue.
  • You’ll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI.
  • Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines.
  • Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved.
  • Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value.
  • Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured “silent churn” playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces.
  • Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.

Buscamos um(a) profissional sênior para atuar com SAP MM/PTP em ambiente SAP S/4HANA (Public Cloud), apoiando iniciativas de implementação e sustentação dos processos de compras e gestão de fornecedores. • Configurar e otimizar fluxos de compras (workflows), incluindo requisições, pedidos de compra, recebimento de mercadorias e processamento de faturas.

• Documentar processos, configurações e melhores práticas para compartilhamento de conhecimento.

• Inglês fluente. (Obrigatório)

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Golang)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Forward Deployed Engineer (Golang) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil Remote

Department: Engineering

Employment Type: Contract (B2B)

Contract Length: 6 months


About YLD:

Our goal is to help our clients keep moving forward. We work with them to build the skills and capabilities they need to stay ahead of the competition, and we know our success only happens when they succeed. We’re a team of curious, talented people, and we’re committed to making YLD a place where great people want to work, grow, and stay. We’re a remote-first consultancy specialising in software engineering, product design, and data. Our teams are based across London, Lisbon, and Porto, and we create digital solutions that continue to deliver value long after our work is done.


About the role:

As a Forward Deployment Engineer at YLD, you'll be part of a client team building innovative products. We're looking for someone curious, passionate, driven, and enthusiastic. You should be skilled in problem-solving and experienced in designing scalable, resilient, and fault-tolerant architectures. You're also an effective communicator and a strong team player. Together with your team, you'll thrive in a fast-paced engineering environment, delivering outstanding results and exciting projects.


Your day-to-day responsibilities can look like this:

  • Design, build, and maintain robust backend and infrastructure systems using Golang and Java with contributions across the broader engineering stack
  • Work closely with client teams in collaborative working sessions, explaining technical decisions and translating complex engineering concepts clearly
  • Deploy and manage cloud infrastructure across AWS and GCP using Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), Terraform , and Flux
  • Actively leverage AI-powered tools and workflows to accelerate development, improve code quality, and drive engineering best practices


Preferred skills:

  • Strong backend and infrastructure engineering background, with hands-on Golang and Java experience;
  • Experience developing or integrating decentralised systems, data infrastructure, or distributed technologies;
  • Solid command of cloud infrastructure: AWS , GCP , Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), Terraform , and Flux ;
  • Actively and meaningfully using AI tools in day-to-day coding practice (not just awareness, but advanced, habitual use);
  • Familiarity with TigerBeetle, YugabyteDB, or Red Panda;
  • Experience in fintech, core banking, or regulated financial services environments;
  • Open to occasional travel to London.


You should apply if you are:

  • Proactive: You take ownership and move things forward without waiting to be asked;
  • A strong communicator: you express technical ideas clearly, in writing and in client-facing conversations, with full professional fluency in English;
  • Confident presenting: you bring a polished, engaged attitude to working sessions and stakeholder interactions;
  • Focused on quality: you care about doing things properly and hold yourself to a high standard;
  • Pragmatic: you make sensible trade-offs and deliver results in ambiguous, fast-moving environments;
  • A creative problem solver: you approach hard engineering challenges with curiosity and ingenuity;
  • Collaborative: you thrive on working within cross-functional, distributed teams and value others' input.


What you’ll get in return:

  • The chance to work with a forward-thinking, ethical, and fun group of people and to develop and grow your skills in a fast-moving business


Our typical recruitment process:

  • 1st Interview with someone from the Talent team (30/45 mins)
  • Technical Interview with our Senior Developers (1h30)
  • Final chat with our Client Partner (30/45 mins)

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:

JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who are we?

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.


Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing.


About the role

This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs.


You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here.



Key responsibilities

  • Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way.
  • Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable.
  • Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations.
  • Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome.
  • Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit.
  • Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you.
  • Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.


Must haves

  • 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly.
  • Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs.
  • Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency.
  • Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits.
  • Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma.
  • Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives.
  • Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.


Nice to have

  • Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar).
  • Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms.
  • Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar).
  • Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique.
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; JavaScript a plus.
  • Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.

REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia.
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

  • Gestão de Receita (Revenue Intelligence): Controlar o MRR (Receita Recorrente Mensal), gerenciar a separação entre receitas recorrentes e avulsas, e garantir a correta contabilização de provisões e diferimentos de receita;
  • Planejamento Financeiro (Budget e Forecast): Conduzir e suportar o processo de planejamento financeiro da companhia (Budget, Forecast e revisões periódicas), garantindo consistência das premissas e alinhamento com a estratégia do negócio;
  • Acompanhamento de Resultados (Realizado vs. Planejado): Analisar o desempenho financeiro (DRE gerencial), identificando variações, causas e impactos, com recomendações claras para tomada de decisão;
  • Análises Gerenciais e Suporte à Decisão: Construir análises financeiras e operacionais que suportem decisões estratégicas, incluindo rentabilidade, eficiência operacional e alocação de recursos;
  • Modelagem Financeira: Desenvolver e manter modelos financeiros (cenários, projeções e simulações), apoiando decisões de crescimento, investimentos e priorização de iniciativas;
  • Indicadores de Performance (KPIs): Definir, acompanhar e evoluir indicadores financeiros e operacionais, garantindo visibilidade e clareza sobre a performance da empresa;
  • Suporte às Áreas de Negócio (Business Partnering): Atuar como parceiro financeiro das áreas, apoiando líderes na leitura de resultados, construção de metas e acompanhamento de performance;
  • Métricas SaaS e Unit Economics: Consolidar e analisar KPIs críticos: Churn (Logo e Net Revenue), Expansão, NRR, LTV e CAC;
  • Automação e Melhoria de Processos: Identificar oportunidades de melhoria, padronização e automação dos processos de planejamento e análise financeira;
  • Construção de Relatórios Executivos: Elaborar materiais para diretoria e stakeholders (reports, apresentações e dashboards), com clareza, objetividade e foco em decisão;
  • Integração com Controladoria e Financeiro: Garantir consistência entre dados gerenciais e contábeis, atuando de forma integrada com as áreas de controladoria e financeiro.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência consolidada em FP&A, modelagem financeira e controle orçamentário;

  • Experiência com construção de apresentações executivas;
  • Conhecimento em métricas de receita recorrente (MRR, churn, LTV, CAC, NRR).


Informações adicionais

Também é legal se você tiver:

  • Vivência em empresas SaaS ou de tecnologia;

  • Experiência com ferramentas de ERP (Sankhya) e integração de dados;
  • Vivência com automação de processos e uso de IA aplicada a finanças;
  • Experiência em ambientes de alto crescimento (scale-up);

description:

About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.

So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving forward. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.

We're looking for a Technology Manager to partner closely with local and global teams across Operations, Product, Risk, and Compliance on technology initiatives.


You'll ensure local technology frameworks, systems, and governance align with both group standards and Brazilian regulatory expectations.


Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What you'll need

  • Familiarity with regulatory and security requirements in Brazil, including cybersecurity, outsourcing, operational risk management, and data protection

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday.
