title: AI Development Orchestrator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Development Orchestrator em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time

Reports to: CEO

Stack: TypeScript, Python, React (Next.js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git

Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users

Start: Immediate


The Company

Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.


The Role

You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems; the agents think in code.

Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem; the strongest output is selected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.


What You Do

  • Review every AI-generated commit. Not \"does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\"
  • Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear.
  • Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage.
  • Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent.
  • Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix.
  • Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.


Must-Haves

  • Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer; the AI is the author.
  • Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant.
  • TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems.
  • React in production. Next.js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns.
  • Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it.
  • Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down.
  • Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations.
  • Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.


Strong Signals

  • Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison.
  • Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code).
  • Database-level access control in production.
  • Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling.
  • OWASP Top 10 fluency.
  • Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.


Red Flags

  • AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you.
  • Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance.
  • Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify.
  • Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review.
  • Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack.
  • Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership.
  • No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.


Who This Person Is

3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant.

You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.


How We Evaluate

No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing.

  • Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom?
  • Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything.
  • Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output?
  • AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.


What We Offer

  • A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access.
  • The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory.
  • Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately.
  • A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only.
  • A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI; quality comes from you.


To Apply or Refer

Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

title: Médico Pediatra (RQE)

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO PEDIATRA (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Pediatria! *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Estamos em busca de Médico/a Pediatra, comprometidos e capacitados para se juntarem à nossa equipe multidisciplinar. Nosso time de médicos desempenham um papel crucial no suporte dos pacientes, para sanar suas dúvidas, atender as demandas de saúde de acordo com a necessidade de cada um, através de nossa plataforma online. Se você é um profissional licenciado, focado em resultados e apaixonado por fazer a diferença na vida dos pacientes, queremos conhecer você!


O médico será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, na modalidade especialidade em Pediatria , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


PAPEL E RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Pediatria de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de crianças e adolescentes em suas múltiplas facetas e condições.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Pediatria e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Competência na avaliação pediátrica, incluindo o reconhecimento de problemas e doenças que possam estar presente nesta faixa etária.


  • Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais através de vídeochamada com o responsável.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças de acordo com o diagnóstico e faixa etária .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde da criança e do adolescente.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Pediatria.


  • Garantir o respeito ao ECA (Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente) com respeito aos seus direitos e prerrogativas para o cuidado em saúde.


  • Realizar consulta individualizada ao adolescente sem necessidade de responsável a partir dos 12 anos de idade conforme previsto pelo ECA (Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente), caso solicitado ou quando avaliada necessária.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe crianças e adolescentes a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS E PREFERÊNCIAS DE HABILIDADES


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM PEDIATRIA


Certificações:

  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Pediatria - RQE emitido pelo Conselho respectivo ;
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Pediatria , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;

This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced fintech environment and is passionate about balancing compliance excellence with business enablement.

  • Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of onboarding controls, policies, and procedures to ensure efficiency, scalability, and regulatory compliance.

  • Perform detailed reviews and analysis of B2B customer documentation, including Customer Risk Assessments and Customer Due Diligence to support informed onboarding decisions.
  • Partner with Sales, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to provide clear guidance on compliance requirements, enabling smooth client onboarding and expansion into new markets. Advise internal teams on AML risks and regulatory considerations when entering new industries or geographic regions.
  • Conduct background checks, adverse media screenings, and ongoing monitoring of clients and prospects to identify and mitigate potential risks.
  • Support the Compliance function in applying regulatory frameworks across LATAM jurisdictions, ensuring compliant operations in Brazil matters.


What We’re Looking For


  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, with a strong foundation in Compliance.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in Compliance, preferably within fintech, digital banking, payments, or financial services environments.
  • Strong knowledge of KYC, AML, CDD, and CRA frameworks
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian AML/CTF regulations
  • Familiarity with international regulatory standards, including BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, and OFAC
  • Ability to evaluate complex customer structures, identify risks, and make sound compliance decisions.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and communicate complex regulatory concepts clearly.
  • Fluent in Spanish (English is a strong plus).
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-growing environment with evolving regulatory landscapes.

title: Médico Cardiologista
description:

Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Cardiologia . Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

Nosso time de profissionais desempenha um papel crucial no suporte dos pacientes, para sanar suas dúvidas, atender as demandas de saúde de acordo com a necessidade de cada um, através de nossa plataforma online. Se você é um profissional licenciado, focado em resultados e apaixonado por fazer a diferença na vida dos pacientes, queremos conhecer você!


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade cardiologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


PAPEL E RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em cardiologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios cardiológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em cardiologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças cardiológica s.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em cardiologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS E PREFERÊNCIAS DE HABILIDADES


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM CARDIOLOGIA, ou Especialização, residência concluída, ou em andamento.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Registro do Título de Especialista em cardiologia (RQE), emitido pelo Conselho Regional de Medicina do respectivo Estado ; ou matrícula em curso de residência, especialização, ou pós, em andamento;
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em cardiologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Médico competente em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com problemas de saúde cardiológicos .


Competências Comportamentais:

Médico comprometido com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.


REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Project Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company

Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions.


About the Role

The Technical Project Manager will work closely with engineering and collaborate with client experience, operations, and leadership to manage technical projects from planning through completion. This person should be organized, clear, and comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This is not a purely administrative project management role. The right person should understand enough about software, APIs, data, incident management, change management, and technical dependencies to ask good questions, spot blockers, and help teams stay aligned. Familiarity with ITIL practices is important, especially around incident management, change management, service management, problem management, and continuous improvement.


Responsibilities

  • Manage technical projects across engineering, product, and operations.
  • Help define project scope, timelines, milestones, owners, and priorities.
  • Track progress and make sure work is moving forward.
  • Identify blockers, risks, and dependencies early.
  • Keep stakeholders updated on status, changes, and next steps.
  • Coordinate technical work involving APIs, data, internal tools, customer workflows, IT systems, and integrations.
  • Help organize Jira tickets, documentation, meeting notes, and follow-ups.
  • Make sure decisions, requirements, and action items are clearly documented.
  • Support launch planning, testing coordination, and rollout communication.
  • Support incident follow-ups, change coordination, and post-implementation reviews.
  • Help improve lightweight processes around service delivery, technical operations, and project execution.
  • Improve processes that help the team move faster without adding unnecessary overhead.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in technical project management, project management, product operations, engineering operations, engineering project management, or a similar role.
  • Experience working with software engineering teams.
  • Familiarity with ITIL practices, including incident management, change management, problem management, service management, and continuous improvement.
  • Strong understanding of basic technical concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations, cloud systems, IT systems, and production releases.
  • Strong communication and organization skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities.
  • Able to turn unclear problems into clear next steps.
  • Experience using tools like Jira Software, Confluence, Slack, GitHub, Jira Service Management, or similar platforms.


Required Skills

  • ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience in fintech, payments, fraud prevention, chargebacks, banking, or risk.
  • Experience working on customer integrations or partner integrations.
  • Basic SQL knowledge.
  • Experience working at a startup or small fast-moving company.
  • Familiarity with compliance, reporting, audits, service management, or operational workflows.


What Success Looks Like

  • Projects have clear owners, timelines, and next steps.
  • Engineering has fewer interruptions caused by unclear requirements or missing coordination.
  • Leadership has better visibility into what is being worked on, what is blocked, and what needs a decision.
  • Teams are aligned before launches, production changes, and major operational updates.
  • Incidents, changes, and follow-up actions are tracked clearly.
  • Work gets delivered more consistently without adding unnecessary process.


Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is organized, technical enough to understand engineering and IT discussions, and practical enough to keep things moving. They should be able to communicate clearly, follow up consistently, and help bring structure to fast-moving projects without slowing the team down.

title: Paid Ads QA Auditor - Global
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Paid Ads QA Auditor - Global em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you obsessive about catching what others miss?


Do you notice inconsistencies without being told where to look?


Do you get satisfaction from identifying errors before they become problems?


Final question: when faced with a challenge, do you get excited or run away?


If that sounds like you, you may be the perfect fit for our Paid Ads QA role.


At Crisp, we're on a mission to help 10,000 law firms each grow their revenue by $10,000,000 over the next 10 years, creating a $10 billion impact in the legal industry.


Our Paid Ads team is responsible for executing paid media campaigns that power our law firm clients’ brand awareness and growth across major digital platforms. These campaigns are deployed across hundreds of client accounts and multiple platforms simultaneously.


This role exists to ensure those campaigns are executed accurately, consistently, and in alignment with internal standards and client intent.


This is a non-client-facing, audit-focused role that requires extreme attention to detail, strong system thinking, and the discipline to identify and document discrepancies with zero tolerance for preventable error.


However, it is not a “task-ing” role, or a role where you’ll be constantly told what to do - you’ll be expected to self-sufficiently spot and correct errors, but most importantly, get ahead of them before even happening, including improving existing systems.


** IMPORTANT: TO APPLY **

You will be evaluated and vetted based on your ability to follow instructions:

Follow this Willo link (recorded interview platform), and answer the few questions on there, first.Then reply to the ad, stating you’ve completed the Willo, and we will be in touch.


Key Responsibilities Include:


Campaign Audit & Validation

  • Audit paid advertising campaigns across Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn, TikTok, streaming platforms, and others
  • Verify that the correct creative assets, ad copy, and campaign structures are deployed on the correct client accounts
  • Ensure campaigns align with intended funnel stages and approved execution parameters


Execution Accuracy & Cross-Account Integrity

  • Identify discrepancies such as:
  • Incorrect assets deployed to the wrong client
  • Mismatched ad copy or campaign configurations
  • Inconsistent implementation across platforms
  • Ensure campaign execution matches internal direction and client-specific setup


Budget & Pacing Verification

  • Audit campaign budgets to ensure alignment with approved allocations
  • Identify risks of underdelivery or overspend
  • Validate that budget adjustments and reallocations are executed correctly


Tracking, Links & Technical QA

  • Verify accuracy and functionality of:
  • URLs and landing pages
  • UTM parameters and tracking links
  • Pixel and tag implementation (where applicable)
  • Identify gaps in tracking integrity and flag inconsistencies


Instruction Fidelity & Change Validation

  • Compare campaign execution against:
  • Internal strategy direction
  • Client Success Manager requests
  • Campaign updates or pivots
  • Ensure requested changes are implemented accurately and completely


Audit Documentation & Communication

  • Document audit findings clearly, with supporting context and evidence
  • Categorize issues based on severity (e.g., minor discrepancy vs. critical error)
  • Communicate findings in a structured format that enables efficient resolution


Audit Operations (Evolving Scope)


This role may operate across a range of audit models depending on business needs, including:

Audit Cadence:

  • Pre-launch validation
  • Post-launch verification
  • Ongoing daily, weekly, or periodic audits

Audit Coverage:

  • Full account audits
  • Targeted sampling across accounts

Audit Depth:

  • Surface-level validation (assets, placements, links)
  • Deeper audits (budget pacing, tracking, structural accuracy)

Ownership Scope:

  • Identifying and flagging discrepancies
  • Recommending corrective actions
  • Supporting enforcement of quality standards


Our requirements are pretty straightforward. To qualify you must:

  • Be highly detail-oriented — you catch inconsistencies others miss
  • Think in structured processes, checklists, and systems
  • Be proactive in identifying issues and asking clarifying questions
  • Be comfortable operating with incomplete information and making sound judgments
  • Have strong written communication skills
  • Be tech-savvy and able to learn new platforms quickly
  • Be comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment


Preferred Experience:

  • Experience auditing or QA-ing digital campaigns (launches, changes, tracking)
  • Familiarity with UTM structures, tracking links, and link verification
  • Experience working with dashboards or reporting tools
  • Experience using project management or task tracking tools (Asana, Monday, etc.)


Nice to Have:

  • Salesforce or CRM familiarity
  • Experience with Supermetrics or similar data connectors
  • Familiarity with Google Looker Studio or similar dashboards
  • Experience documenting processes or building SOPs
  • Experience in a fast-paced, multi-client environment


Platform Exposure (Preferred, Not Required):

  • Meta Ads Manager
  • Google Ads
  • Google Tag Manager (GTM)
  • TikTok Ads
  • LinkedIn Ads
  • TradeDesk


Why Our Work Matters:


Lawyers go to law school to learn how to practice law, but law school doesn’t teach them how to run a business. In a world where the best cases often go to the best marketers, legal expertise alone isn’t enough.


That’s where Crisp comes in.


We partner with committed, growth-minded law firms that care deeply about their teams, clients, and communities. Often, it’s a David vs. Goliath scenario, where the most dedicated attorneys lack the resources of their larger competitors.


Our work levels the playing field by giving law firms access to world-class marketing execution that helps them stand out, build authority, and grow sustainably.


About Crisp:

Crisp has been recognized on the Inc. 5000 (Fastest Growing Private Companies in the U.S. – 2024, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017), as well as Atlanta's Top 100 Fastest Growing Private Companies (2025, 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017, 2016) and Atlanta's Best Places to Work (2024, 2023, 2022).


Crisp ( is the nation’s fastest-growing law firm growth company. We’ve helped thousands of attorneys — from solo and small firms to large practices — build their brand, differentiate themselves from competitors, attract better cases, and earn millions in new revenue.

Crisp has been featured in Forbes, Inc., Avvo, ABA Journal, The Trial Lawyer, Huffington Post, and The Wall Street Journal.


OUR BOOK:

The Game Changing Attorney (available on Amazon and Barnes & Noble)


OUR PODCAST:

The Game Changing Attorney Podcast


Why You Should Work Here:

  • You will work inside a structured, high-performance marketing operation
  • You will contribute to campaigns running at scale across hundreds of accounts
  • You will play a direct role in improving execution accuracy and system reliability
  • You will be trusted to identify and surface critical issues


This is not a role for someone looking for easy work or vague expectations.

This is a role for someone who takes pride in enforcing standards, identifying errors, and ensuring systems operate correctly.


** IMPORTANT: TO APPLY **

You will be evaluated and vetted based on your ability to follow instructions:

Follow this Willo link (recorded interview platform), and answer the few questions on there, first.Then reply to the ad, stating you’ve completed the Willo, and we will be in touch.

We identify the obstacles slowing progress, then work with partners to design and run collaborative campaigns that remove them. We bring together allies across civil society, policy and industry to influence the narrative and politics of energy.


The transition to clean energy can improve everything: lower bills, better jobs, cleaner air and more connected communities. Yet progress is still too slow and increasingly vulnerable to misinformation and political backlash.


Now entering our third year, SEP is leading global communications efforts, coordinating campaign coalitions, and launching audience-led interventions in key countries. We're helping the climate movement fight smarter, faster, and together.


Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for a Campaign Director to help tell a bigger, bolder story about the energy transition - inspiring people to see clean energy as the foundation for healthier lives, stronger communities and greater security.


You’ll help shift how people think and talk about energy by building communications that reach beyond the usual audiences. You’ll work with influencers, community voices, experts and unexpected allies to make clean energy feel practical, popular and urgent.


To change everything, it takes everyone. That’s why you’ll help SEP play a leading role in networks that bring together hundreds of organisations working towards the same goal. You’ll spot opportunities for collaboration, support the leadership of others and help turn shared ambition into joint projects that are more than the sum of their parts.


Working closely with the Senior Director, you’ll deliver news-driven, cutting-edge communications, support rapid-response work and coordinate with partners across our global network to share intelligence, test ideas and collaborate on high-impact interventions in public and political debates.

This role is ideal for a strong communicator or campaigner who is both strategic and hands-on. You can translate big-picture strategy into compelling content, build trusted relationships with collaborators and move quickly when opportunities arise.


We’re looking for someone who is ahead of the curve on communications and campaigns. You understand that speeding up the shift to clean energy means breaking out of echo chambers, building alliances with new audiences and unlikely partners, and shaping news agendas in real time with digital-first, innovative tactics. You’ll bring both the patience to take people with you and the punchiness to help shift the movement into a different gear.


What you’ll do Drive narrative change on energy transition

  • Work closely with the Senior Director to deliver SEP’s communications campaigns.
  • Design innovative strategies, materials and interventions for major moments in the clean energy calendar, including summits, geopolitical events, campaign launches and report releases.
  • Translate audience insights, polling and political analysis into strategic communications outputs tailored to specific audiences.
  • Turn campaign strategy into creative ideas and interventions that can shift how people think and talk about energy.
  • Help strengthen the wider clean energy movement by supporting the day-to-day coordination of SEP’s global networks and coalitions.
  • Plan and run meetings, workshops and follow-up processes that encourage lively communication, practical collaboration and shared delivery.
  • Build clear workplans, outputs and timelines to support delivery across multiple fast-moving projects.
  • Track progress and keep partners and donors up to speed on what’s working, what’s not, and what that means for our collective impact.


Narrative monitoring and rapid response coordination 

  • Spot the moments that matter - tracking media, politics and digital conversations to identify where clean energy narratives can be advanced, defended or reframed.
  • Coordinate partners across SEP’s coalitions so the right voices are ready to speak out quickly, confidently and effectively.
  • Produce rapid-response materials, including key messages, talking points, media pitches, briefing notes and digital content.
  • Help SEP and its partners prepare for major events, risks and opportunities with clear plans, strong narratives and timely interventions.


Media pitching and spokesperson training 

  • Support media outreach by drafting pitches, building targeted media lists, maintaining journalist relationships and proactively spotting opportunities to place clean energy stories and spokespeople.
  • Identify strong spokespeople from across the clean energy NGO community and help prepare them for media interviews through messaging guidance, briefing materials and training opportunities.
  • Build a broader, more diverse network of trusted voices for clean energy - including farmers, workers, community organisers, clean tech entrepreneurs, local leaders and others who can speak credibly to their own communities.
  • Work with the Senior Director and other Communications Directors to activate spokespeople across traditional media and strategic online spaces.


Strategic support and special projects

  • Support the Senior Director with the design and delivery of new or evolving priority projects, ie. with our existing campaign to promote the benefits of solar power in Nigeria, or a cross-country campaign we’re developing to turbocharge electrification in the lead-up to COP31. 
  • Assist in drafting materials for fundraising proposals and donor communications.


About you:

  • You have a hunger to change the world, and are willing to take risks to change it. 
  • You think innovatively about communications and campaigns - you enjoy experimenting with new and outside-the-box approaches.
  • You can influence people - you understand what makes people tick and how to get them on-side. 
  • You think strategically and you can also get things done. 
  • You’re extremely organised and you like keeping other people organised too. 
  • You're proactive - you don’t wait around to be asked to do something, you take the initiative and crack on. 
  • You don’t shy away from picking up the phone to strangers or chasing people who are ignoring your emails. 
  • You are confident enough to ask 'why?', to question the judgement of those more senior than you, and to admit when you’ve made mistakes. 
  • You have a good sense of humour, you don’t take yourself too seriously and you have excellent people management skills.
  • You are comfortable working in an organisation guided by feminist values and have zero tolerance for misogyny, racism and bullying.  


Essential skills and experience

  • 5+ years of experience in a communications, campaigns or media role. Does not have to be within the NGO sector.
  • A creative mindset and strong interest in using storytelling and digital campaigning to drive change.
  • Experience supporting or delivering communications campaigns. 
  • Strong writing and editing skills, with a track record for producing impactful media and digital content.
  • Experience pitching to the media, drafting press releases and media briefings, and identifying and supporting spokespeople to deliver messages effectively. 
  • Good understanding of energy and climate issues, or proven ability to quickly build subject knowledge.
  • Experience working across teams, organisations, and geographies.
  • Highly organised, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote environment.
  • Excellent English. Fluent Spanish would be a bonus, but it’s not essential. 


What we offer

  • A chance to produce communications work that accelerates the transition to clean and affordable energy and changes the world in the process.
  • The opportunity to get in on the ground floor of a small, high-ambition feminist start-up with a growing reputation.
  • A collaborative, flexible, values-driven team with space to test and learn.
  • Flexible working conditions, because childcare or other caring responsibilities are not hobbies.
  • Opportunities to work across borders with partners and change-makers in climate and energy.
  • Competitive compensation. Approx. USD $50,000 depending on location and experience.


How to apply

Do not apply through LinkedIn. Please apply by answering the role-specific questions which can be found here (

  • Deadline June 1st 9am BST

title: Editor de Vídeos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Editor de Vídeos em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Vaga: Editor(a) de Vídeo Júnior — 100% Remoto | CLT + Plano de Saúde + Bônus


LEIA ATÉ O FINAL COM ATENÇÃO - NÃO ADIANTA SÓ CLICAR EM SE CANDIDATAR AQUI NO LINKEDIN


Em menos de 2 anos, possivelmente, já somos a maior clínica de fisioterapia pélvica particular do Brasil e nosso ritmo de crescimento é acelerado e cada vez mais rápido.


Conteúdo é um dos motores desse crescimento. Cada corte que sai da nossa edição educa pacientes, quebra tabus sobre disfunções íntimas e mostra que existe tratamento sério para problemas que a maioria dos lugares trata errado.


Agora estamos abrindo vaga para um(a) Editor(a) de Vídeo Júnior que queira entrar nesse time, aprender rápido e crescer junto.


O pacote


• Salário fixo: R$ 1.830


• Ajuda de custo: R$ 300


• Bônus mensal de até R$ 300 (por desempenho e comportamento)


• Plano de saúde


• Regime CLT, 100% remoto


Total possível inicial: até R$ 2.430/mês + plano de saúde.


Cargo Júnior. Mas não é uma vaga para quem quer ficar Júnior. Quem entrega, evolui rápido para Pleno — esse é o nosso jeito de operar em todos os cargos.


A vaga em uma frase


Assistir vídeos longos da PelvClinic, achar os melhores trechos e transformar em cortes curtos que prendem atenção no Reels, TikTok e Shorts.


A edição técnica importa. Mas escolher o corte certo importa mais. Saber identificar qual trecho começa forte, qual fala gera curiosidade, qual explicação tem valor — esse é o olhar que faz a diferença entre um editor comum e um editor que move o ponteiro.


É isso que vamos te ensinar e cobrar.


Como você vai trabalhar


Você será liderado(a) pela Emilly, nossa Social Media, que vai te orientar no dia a dia: demanda, feedback, padrão de qualidade, prioridades.


Trabalho remoto exige maturidade. Você precisa ter:


• Computador próprio com capacidade real para edição


• Boa internet


• Organização para entregar sem ser lembrado


• Disponibilidade para alinhamentos com a Emilly


Se você precisa de cobrança constante para produzir, essa vaga não é pra você.


O que estamos buscando


Três coisas — em ordem de importância:


1. Olho para conteúdo. Capacidade de assistir uma hora de vídeo e identificar os 30 segundos que prendem atenção sozinhos.


2. Constância. Entregar bem hoje, amanhã e na semana que vem. Não picos seguidos de sumiço.


3. Vontade real de crescer. Pessoa que estuda referência por conta própria, aceita feedback sem peso, aplica e volta melhor.


>>>Teste prático (Passo 1)<<<


Vídeo de explicação do teste:


A sua pontuação no teste terá base na qualidade e quantidade de bons cortes e conteúdos que conseguir extrair de cada vídeo longo:


• Vídeos curtos de alcance em formato 16:9 (geralmente de 20 segundos até 2 minutos — topo de funil)


• Vídeos médios de 2 a 7 minutos formato 16:9, mais completos e explicados, para gerar mais profundidade de relacionamento (meio e fundo de funil)


• Carrosséis, tanto dos vídeos longos base, quanto dos vídeos menores


FAQ: tem número de vídeos que vocês imaginam?


O teste é para ver a sua capacidade de extrair o maior número de bons conteúdos e ideias possível de cada vídeo longo (vídeos menores e posts/carrosséis).


P.S. Os vídeos já foram editados por nós, e essa será a régua para classificação.


Vídeos longos base (extrair vídeos curtos e carrosséis):


Vídeo 1:


Vídeo 2:


Quanto maior o número e a qualidade dos conteúdos, mais alta sua pontuação.


Penalização por conteúdos ruins ou fracos. Sem encher linguiça — o que conta é volume de conteúdos bons.


Critérios de avaliação:


• Seleção de tema e clareza da ideia


• Título / Headline escrito


• Gancho falado — força nos 0–3s e 0–7s, curiosidade e interesse sem clickbait


• Entrega de conteúdo — satisfação depois de consumir


• Comunicação da marca — ética, acolhimento, evidência, linguagem simples


• Velocidade e capricho — quanto mais rápido melhor, arquivos nomeados, zero ruído


Referências de vídeos curtos:

• Quem reage a feedback como ataque


• Quem quer fazer o mínimo e receber o suficiente

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Salesforce Developer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo 7° ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília!


Sobre a posição:

  • Realizar desenvolvimento Apex (Visualforce, Triggers, Classes Apex, Classes de teste, Componentes Lightning) de diversos níveis de complexidade sem dependência;
  • Implementar funcionalidades e corrigir bugs;
  • Realizar levantamento de requisitos técnicos com o time e tradução em soluções, seguindo as boas práticas de desenvolvimento.


Buscamos alguém com:

  • Boas práticas para desenvolvimento de Apex classes, Triggers, Components de soluções customizadas;
  • Microserviços, Webservice REST e SOAP;

description:

Required Skills & Experience


• 5+ years in Technical Program Management, Program Management, or Delivery/Project Leadership in software/product environments.

• Strong experience working with engineering teams (front-end, back-end, APIs, integrations) and translating requirements into execution plans.

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple parallel workstreams with dependencies, ambiguity, and shifting priorities.

• Comfort operating in Agile delivery environments and facilitating common delivery ceremonies.

• Strong ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders—written, verbal, and executive-ready status reporting.

• Proven organizational skills: structured thinking, attention to detail, follow-through, and accountability.


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


• CPG experience (Consumer Packaged Goods) or work supporting enterprise-scale commerce, marketing, or customer platforms.

• Experience using GitHub for product/engineering workflows (issues, epics, project boards, milestones, release tracking).

• AI workflow experience (automation, copilots/assistants, orchestration tools, or applied AI to improve delivery ops).

• Experience supporting digital commerce capabilities (e.g., customer experience, product catalogs, order flows, promotions, personalization, content, analytics).

• Familiarity with Elixir and/or React environments—enough to partner effectively with engineers, understand constraints, and anticipate delivery risks.


Job Description


The Digital Commerce team is seeking a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to amplify product delivery and relieve a Product Manager who is currently balancing product discovery alongside multiple concurrent projects. This TPM will drive program execution across cross-functional teams—translating product intent into clear plans, predictable delivery, and measurable outcomes—while ensuring work is well-managed in GitHub (where our PM workflows now live). This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of product, engineering, and operations—bringing structure, visibility, and momentum to complex initiatives, and enabling the PM to focus on customer and market discovery.

• Own end-to-end program management for multiple digital commerce initiatives, from intake through delivery and rollout.

• Build and maintain integrated plans (milestones, dependencies, risks, resourcing, timeline) across product, engineering, data, QA, security, and partner teams.

• Drive delivery rituals: standups, sprint/iteration planning support, backlog readiness, dependency reviews, status reporting, and go/no-go readiness.

• Serve as the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders—ensuring alignment on scope, sequencing, tradeoffs, and “definition of done.”

• Proactively manage dependencies, risks, and decisions; escalate with context and options, not just problems.

• Ensure clear communication across teams and leadership with concise updates and action-oriented readouts.

• Help standardize how initiatives are tracked in GitHub (e.g., issues, epics, project boards, milestones), driving consistent hygiene and visibility.

• Improve team throughput by reducing friction in processes and tooling (templates, workflows, reporting, intake). • Identify opportunities to use AI-enabled workflows to reduce overhead (e.g., release comms drafting, backlog grooming support, automated status summaries, incident triage workflows, documentation acceleration) while maintaining governance and quality.

• Partner with engineering and product to implement pragmatic automation that improves delivery efficiency.

• Coordinate release plans across teams: readiness checklists, rollout sequencing, communication plans, training/support readiness, and post-launch monitoring.

• Ensure operational handoffs and documentation are complete for production support.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Node.js/React.js)

title: Java Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Java Software Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

Theta Data is a pioneering data company specializing in low-latency APIs for delivering high-speed options and stocks data. Our mission is to empower users with real-time, actionable information to make well-informed decisions in dynamic financial markets. With a focus on speed and broad data coverage, Theta Data stands at the forefront of the options data industry by providing essential tools and insights. We are dedicated to equipping professionals with the resources needed to excel in a competitive landscape.


We’re a small, nimble team growing quickly. Our platform handles billions of database requests daily, and we’re just getting started. The complexity of our data problems is real: tick-level options data is among the most intricate financial data to store, index, and serve at scale. We take engineering seriously.


Role Description

We’re hiring backend-focused Software Engineers to help build and scale the services that power Theta Data. This is a hands-on coding role. You’ll be writing production code from day one. We are looking for self-starting engineers who think deeply about system scale, creatively solve problems, and can move forward in high ambiguity.


You’ll join a lean engineering team where your work has a direct, visible impact on the platform and the customers who use it. We have new services to architect, bottlenecks to eliminate, and workflows to redesign from scratch.


Additionally, you’ll support live systems, investigate and resolve bugs, and help keep a platform that customers depend on running smoothly.


What you will work on

  • Design, build, and scale backend services handling billions of requests daily
  • Architect new systems and contribute to technical direction
  • Improve and automate customer onboarding workflows
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across the stack
  • Collaborate directly with the team and senior technical leadership


Our Technical Stack

  • Java - core backend services, business logic, API, thick client
  • Python - scripting, tooling
  • Apache Tomcat - servlet container
  • Java Servlets - HTTP request handling
  • PostgreSQL + Hibernate
  • gRPC
  • AI coding tools (Claude, Gemini, Copilot) - we use them, you should too


What we are looking for

We hire for fundamentals, ownership, and a love of building. Depending on your experience level, here’s what we care about:


Required

  • Deep proficiency in Java with a strong command of the language and ecosystem
  • Proven experience optimizing application performance through JVM heap tuning, garbage collection analysis, and memory allocation strategies
  • Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and systems-level thinking
  • Demonstrated experience designing, building, and maintaining REST APIs and backend services
  • Working knowledge of HTTP, authentication protocols, and modern web architecture


Nice to Have

  • Experience working in data-intensive, low-latency environments where performance matters
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, including schema design and query optimization
  • Python development experience for tooling, scripting, or service work
  • Familiarity with Apache Tomcat in production or staging environments
  • Frontend exposure with TypeScript and a modern UI library or framework (Vue, React, or similar)
  • Experience designing or maintaining CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment


Why Theta Data

  • Rapid growth: the platform and team are both scaling fast
  • Real engineering challenges: data at scale, low-latency systems, complex financial data
  • High ownership: a small team means your decisions matter and ship quickly
  • Greenfield opportunities: new systems to design, not just legacy to maintain
  • Remote-first: work from anywhere
  • Direct impact: your work reaches thousands of quants and researchers daily

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior DevOps Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior DevOps Engineer (Remote)


We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior DevOps Engineer to support enterprise infrastructure automation and CI/CD modernization initiatives. This role will play a critical part in a large-scale migration to Harness, making hands-on Harness experience mandatory. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), cloud platforms, automation, and DevOps best practices. This engineer will work closely with development, operations, and security teams to streamline deployments, improve reliability, and enhance operational efficiency across enterprise environments.


Key Responsibilities:

CI/CD Pipeline Development & Automation

  • Design, build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Harness, Jenkins, and other automation tools.
  • Lead and support migration efforts from legacy deployment tools and pipelines into Harness.
  • Implement deployment automation strategies to improve release speed, consistency, and reliability.Manage Git-based workflows and support DevOps best practices across engineering teams.

Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Cloud Automation

  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code solutions using Terraform and related tools.
  • Automate provisioning, configuration, and deployment of cloud and on-premises infrastructure.
  • Support cloud environments including AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Ensure infrastructure scalability, security, and high availability across environments.

Containerization & Platform Engineering

  • Deploy and support containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Manage Kubernetes clusters, Helm charts, and cloud-native deployment strategies.
  • Support platform modernization and enterprise DevOps transformation initiatives.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to improve system architecture and deployment standards.

Monitoring, Security & Operational Support

  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and observability solutions to ensure system reliability and uptime.
  • Support DevSecOps initiatives including vulnerability scanning, secrets management, and compliance automation.
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance issues.
  • Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Documentation & Collaboration

  • Maintain detailed technical documentation for infrastructure, pipelines, deployments, and operational procedures.
  • Collaborate with development, infrastructure, QA, and security teams to align DevOps strategies and standards.
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership on DevOps best practices.


Qualifications

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering roles.
  • Mandatory hands-on experience with Harness implementation and administration.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong expertise with Terraform, Jenkins, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Strong knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration technologies.
  • Experience with scripting and automation using Bash, Python, or Groovy.
  • Familiarity with Git/GitOps workflows and version control best practices.
  • Experience implementing monitoring and observability solutions.
  • Strong understanding of DevSecOps concepts and secure deployment practices.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience migrating CI/CD pipelines from Jenkins or other legacy platforms into Harness.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or Azure DevOps.
  • Knowledge of configuration management tools such as Ansible or Puppet.
  • Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), Terraform Associate, or Harness certifications are a plus.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), cloud platforms, automation, and DevOps best practices. This engineer will work closely with development, operations, and security teams to streamline deployments, improve reliability, and enhance operational efficiency across enterprise environments.


Key Responsibilities:

CI/CD Pipeline Development & Automation

  • Design, build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Harness, Jenkins, and other automation tools.
  • Lead and support migration efforts from legacy deployment tools and pipelines into Harness.
  • Implement deployment automation strategies to improve release speed, consistency, and reliability.Manage Git-based workflows and support DevOps best practices across engineering teams.

Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Cloud Automation

  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code solutions using Terraform and related tools.
  • Automate provisioning, configuration, and deployment of cloud and on-premises infrastructure.
  • Support cloud environments including AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Ensure infrastructure scalability, security, and high availability across environments.

Containerization & Platform Engineering

  • Deploy and support containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Manage Kubernetes clusters, Helm charts, and cloud-native deployment strategies.
  • Support platform modernization and enterprise DevOps transformation initiatives.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to improve system architecture and deployment standards.

Monitoring, Security & Operational Support

  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and observability solutions to ensure system reliability and uptime.
  • Support DevSecOps initiatives including vulnerability scanning, secrets management, and compliance automation.
  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance issues.
  • Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Documentation & Collaboration

  • Maintain detailed technical documentation for infrastructure, pipelines, deployments, and operational procedures.
  • Collaborate with development, infrastructure, QA, and security teams to align DevOps strategies and standards.
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership on DevOps best practices.


Qualifications

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering roles.
  • Mandatory hands-on experience with Harness implementation and administration.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong expertise with Terraform, Jenkins, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Strong knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration technologies.
  • Experience with scripting and automation using Bash, Python, or Groovy.
  • Familiarity with Git/GitOps workflows and version control best practices.
  • Experience implementing monitoring and observability solutions.
  • Strong understanding of DevSecOps concepts and secure deployment practices.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience migrating CI/CD pipelines from Jenkins or other legacy platforms into Harness.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or Azure DevOps.
  • Knowledge of configuration management tools such as Ansible or Puppet.
  • Relevant certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), Terraform Associate, or Harness certifications are a plus.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Site Reliability Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:


  • Garantir a disponibilidade, performance e escalabilidade de nossos serviços críticos, com foco em infraestrutura baseada em AWS EC2 (Windows Server e Linux).
  • Desenvolver e implementar ferramentas e processos de automação para monitoramento, provisionamento, gestão de configuração e resolução de incidentes.
  • Identificar e solucionar gargalos de performance e pontos únicos de falha em nossos sistemas.
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento e operações para otimizar a arquitetura e infraestrutura de nossos produtos.
  • Participar ativamente em análises pós-incidente para identificar causas raízes e implementar medidas preventivas.
  • Definir e monitorar SLAs e SLOs para garantir a qualidade dos nossos serviços.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:


  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro(a) de Confiabilidade de Site (SRE) ou função similar.
  • Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática com AWS EC2, incluindo: Criação, configuração e gerenciamento de instâncias EC2; Otimização de performance de instâncias EC2; Escalabilidade e alta disponibilidade de instâncias EC2.
  • Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática com Windows Server, incluindo: Administração de Windows Server; Active Directory; IIS (Internet Information Services); Powershell scripting.
  • Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática com sistemas Linux, incluindo: Administração de servidores Linux (ex: CentOS, Ubuntu); Gerenciamento de pacotes (ex: apt, yum); Shell scripting (Bash); Configuração de serviços (ex: Apache, Nginx).
  • Experiência sólida com Jenkins, incluindo: Criação e gerenciamento de pipelines; Integração com diversas ferramentas (ex: Git, SonarQube, testes automatizados); Configuração de agentes e escalabilidade do Jenkins; Administração do Jenkins e resolução de problemas.

  • Habilidades de comunicação e colaboração.


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:


  • Certificações AWS (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer).
  • Experiência com containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Conhecimento de bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.
  • Experiência com outras ferramentas de CI/CD além de Jenkins.
  • Experiência com Git.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: HNW Client Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para HNW Client Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Remote | Athens HQ support Independent Contractor Uncapped commission with strong earning potential for top performers

Who We Are

Ambitious people deserve options regardless of where they were born.

PassBeyond helps high-net-worth individuals secure residency and citizenship through investment. Our clients invest €250,000–€800,000+ and receive residency or citizenship for themselves and their families — gaining Schengen access, international asset diversification, and long-term optionality.

Founded by Andreas Afeldt, who is based full-time in Athens and has spent over a decade working with high-net-worth clients across international markets. PassBeyond sits between global institutional scale and personal, founder-led trust — with deep local knowledge in Greece and cultural fluency across every market we serve.

We're looking for a Relationship Manager to serve clients from your network.

The Role

This is not a traditional sales role. We're looking for someone who already moves in the same circles as successful entrepreneurs, business owners, and senior professionals — and who can introduce them to an opportunity that provides real security and optionality for their families.

You will:

  • Introduce PassBeyond to high-net-worth individuals in your network
  • Help clients understand the real numbers, real timelines, and real risks — so they can make an informed decision
  • Guide clients from first conversation through to permit in hand
  • Build trust through genuine conversation — not scripts or pressure tactics
  • Work remotely with full support from our Athens headquarters

We're not looking for cold-callers. We're looking for trusted advisors.

Who Our Clients Are

  • Entrepreneurs, business owners, and investors with €250,000–€800,000+ to invest
  • Successful individuals who have built or grown significant wealth
  • Discerning clients who value due diligence and take time to make important decisions
  • Looking for optionality: security, Schengen access, European education, and peace of mind for their families
  • They value relationships over transactions and won't be rushed or pressured

Our clients need someone who understands their world, respects their care in decision-making, and guides with patience and honesty.

What We're Looking For

Essential:

  • Existing relationships with high-net-worth individuals
  • Cultural fluency - you genuinely understand the communities you'd serve
  • Professional working proficiency in English (written and verbal)
  • Comfortable with performance-based compensation
  • Integrity - you'd rather lose a deal than mislead someone

Highly Desirable:

  • Experience in real estate, immigration, wealth management, or financial services

Backgrounds that often do well:

  • Business owners and entrepreneurs
  • Private bankers and wealth managers
  • Lawyers and accountants serving affluent clients
  • Real estate professionals in investment or luxury markets
  • Community leaders and well-connected professionals

What You Get

  • Full training and certification on our programmes — no cost to you
  • Access to our curated property portfolio (60+ vetted developments across Athens)
  • Psychological messaging framework and conversation guides designed for high-stakes, trust-based advisory — not generic sales scripts
  • CRM system for pipeline management
  • Branded marketing materials and property documents ready to share with clients
  • Direct support from our Athens headquarters — legal coordination, transaction management, and immigration filing handled for you
  • As we grow together, you'll receive warm leads from our marketing campaigns alongside your own network

Our Values

Freedom — The right to become who you are capable of becoming, unconstrained by the circumstances of your birth.

Integrity — Not a character trait, but an infrastructure. We engineer trustworthiness into every process.

Partnership — We build relationships, not transactions. We stay with clients long after the permit is approved.

title: Senior Cisco UCS Engineer (REMOTE)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Cisco UCS Engineer (REMOTE) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Infrastructure Engineer - Cisco UCS expert to work remotely from anywhere in Brazil for a client in the US.


MUST BE fluent in English.


The Senior Infrastructure Engineer provides advanced technical expertise within the Managed Services organization and serves as a senior escalation point for complex infrastructure issues. This role is primarily focused on Cisco UCS compute, VMware vCenter/vSphere virtualization, and Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (VDI) environments.

In addition to resolving advanced incidents, this role contributes to technical leadership, root cause analysis, documentation, and the planning and implementation of infrastructure solutions delivered through Professional Services engagements.

Key Responsibilities:


  • Own the full lifecycle of complex infrastructure incidents, from detection through resolution and post-incident review, ensuring accountability for technical outcomes, stability, and documentation.
  • Lead investigation and resolution of critical incidents, driving coordination across internal teams, vendors, and customer stakeholders.
  • Make technical decisions and take end-to-end ownership of infrastructure issues, driving resolution without reliance on further escalation.
  • Lead technical delivery of infrastructure projects, including scoping, estimation, design, and implementation.
  • Perform root cause analysis and develop long-term remediation strategies to prevent recurrence.
  • Validate and approve infrastructure changes, designs, and remediation strategies.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers.
  • Contribute to architecture documentation, diagrams, and operational runbooks.
  • Design and implement automation and process improvements to enhance reliability and operational efficiency.
  • Participate in change management and project planning activities.
  • Accurately track time and project activities within the company's time tracking system.



Requirements

title: FX Trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para FX Trader em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.
